courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接
related.transfer: 可遷移「電阻熱積分」與「焊頭垂向角差」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼軌鋁熱焊接的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Resistance-heat integration" and "Weld vertical angular mismatch" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Aluminothermic rail welding must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據；鋼軌鋁熱焊接則以現場接頭熱量收縮形貌與無損檢測為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on resistance heating upset geometry and weld-quality evidence; Aluminothermic rail welding centres on field-joint heat shrinkage profile and nondestructive inspection, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「電阻熱積分」與「接頭金屬質量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼軌鋁熱焊接，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「孔隙面積比例」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Resistance-heat integration” and “Joint metal mass”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aluminothermic rail welding, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Void area fraction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Resistance-heat integration" and "Weld vertical angular mismatch" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sleeper durability and load testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據；軌枕耐久與承載試驗則以軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on resistance heating upset geometry and weld-quality evidence; Sleeper durability and load testing centres on sleeper bending prestress fatigue and environmental durability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「電阻熱積分」與「簡支跨中彎矩」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到軌枕耐久與承載試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「裂縫開口變化」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Resistance-heat integration” and “Simply supported midspan moment”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sleeper durability and load testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Crack-opening change", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼軌閃光焊接
history.text: 本課把鋼軌閃光焊接放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。閃光對焊把電熱輸入、接合面狀態與頂鍛塑性變形串接；焊後外觀平順只是幾何條件，不能單獨證明熱影響區與內部接合品質。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Flash-butt rail welding in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Flash-butt welding couples electrical heat input, interface condition and upset deformation; a smooth finished profile is a geometric condition and alone does not prove heat-affected-zone or internal bond quality. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「電阻熱積分」到「檢測覆蓋比例」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Resistance-heat integration" through "Inspection coverage fraction" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
